title: 2023 HMMT November Guts Problem 16
statement:
Compute the number of tuples \(\left(a_{0}, a_{1}, a_{2}, a_{3}, a_{4}, a_{5}\right)\) of (not necessarily positive) integers such that \(a_{i} \leq i\) for all \(0 \leq i \leq 5\) and

\[a_{0}+a_{1}+\cdots+a_{5}=6\]

solutions.text:
Let \(b_{i}=i-a_{i}\), so \(b_{i} \geq 0\). Then

\[15-\left(b_{0}+b_{1}+\cdots+b_{5}\right)=6 \Longrightarrow b_{0}+b_{1}+\cdots+b_{5}=9\]

By stars and bars, the answer is \(\binom{14}{5}=2002\).
